prompt: The cute baby dragon, seen from the side and facing right, walks happily in place like on a treadmill with a bouncy, relaxed walk cycle: its little legs step one after the other, its body bobs gently with each step, its tail sways behind it and its small wings flutter a little. It carries nothing. It keeps facing right and stays in exactly the same spot and size in the frame; it does not move across the screen. Soft flat 2D cartoon style exactly like the image, same colours and proportions. The camera is completely locked, no zoom, no pan. The background stays one flat solid green the whole time. No new objects, no text, no shadows. Ends in exactly the starting pose so the walk loops seamlessly.
